########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND iridium_sources
    fft_burst_tagger_impl.cc
    iuchar_to_complex_impl.cc
    tagged_burst_to_pdu_impl.cc
    burst_downmix_impl.cc
    pdu_null_sink_impl.cc
    iridium_qpsk_demod_impl.cc
    tch_c_demod_impl.cc
    tch_c_decoder.cc
    pdu_round_robin_impl.cc
    frame_sorter_impl.cc
    iridium_frame_printer_impl.cc
    fft_channelizer_impl.cc
)

set(iridium_sources "${iridium_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT iridium_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT iridium_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-iridium SHARED ${iridium_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-iridium gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime gnuradio::gnuradio-filter)
target_include_directories(gnuradio-iridium
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  )
set_target_properties(gnuradio-iridium PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_iridium_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-iridium PROPERTIES
        INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
    )
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-iridium)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

# tch_c_decoder is not exported from the library: build it into its test
find_package(Boost QUIET COMPONENTS unit_test_framework)
if(TARGET Boost::unit_test_framework)
    GR_ADD_CPP_TEST(iridium_qa_tch_c_decoder
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_tch_c_decoder.cc;${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tch_c_decoder.cc"
    )
else()
    message(STATUS "Boost.Test not found, skipping the C++ unit tests")
endif()
